title: 第7章 就等你了。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

银色的斧子高高举起，不同角度时反射光的寒芒扫过司陇的脸。

而她的脸上此刻竟无一丝恐惧。

她已将隐藏的匕首掏出，牢牢地握住，使出浑身力气猛地就往钳制住她的触手上刺去。

触手忽然吃痛竟犹如活物一般在空中剧烈抖动挥舞起来，而男生挥起的斧子也在同时猛然掉落在地。

他捂住一边的胳膊，手指缝中渗出血迹，有些不可置信地看向司陇。

这些生成的触手竟然会和他的身体同步受伤，这是她没想到的。

而就在触手松开的瞬间，司陇抓住机会立刻脱离了控制，一个箭步迅速地重新回到了窗边，没有丝毫犹豫的，纵身跃下。

这是她的第一步，先离开大楼。

她要验证梦境边界限制的猜想是不是正确的。

而下一秒，男生就闪现在她身后。

“你要去哪啊？不带上我一起吗？”

“姐姐。”

犹如恶魔般的低语出现在她耳边。

真是阴魂不散，我他*的忍你很久了。

“滚！”司陇暴怒！

她怒目圆睁，额头青筋暴起，全身蓄力转身就是一个结结实实的飞踢，而这一脚到底有多大的力量只有男生知道了。

男生像早就有所防备，双手防御准备接下这一脚。

但他低估了一个暴怒中的人猛烈增长的伤害值，更何况他们的身体素质本身就不在同一个水平线之中。

只听见，咔嚓！！！

一道沉闷的断裂声在空中格外清晰。

司陇这一脚直接踢断了他防御的胳膊。

男生面容皱成一团，像炮弹发射一样，直线飞出，不出几秒便听到“砰！”的一声。

已经被镶嵌在了永夜局的外墙上。

司陇光凭声音便脑补了一切，甚至连回头看一眼的蔑视都懒得给。

一个翻滚卸力，轻巧地落地后，她头也不回的沿着街道继续向远处跑去，她要抓紧时间。

如果不出她所料，在这个梦境里她根本杀不掉对方，他在这里就像能源源不断重生的副本boss，很快就能追上来。

而她现在最重要的，是要立刻实施下一步。

第一步离开大楼，第二步就是找到梦境的边界处。

一直在梦境里她总有力竭的那一刻，到那时才是真的山穷水尽任人宰割。

司陇奋力地在街道上狂奔，所过之处果然没有一丝一毫的人类活动气息。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The silver ax was raised high, and the cold light reflected from different angles swept across Si Long's face.

But there was no trace of fear on her face at this moment.

She had taken out the hidden dagger, held it firmly, and used all her strength to stab the tentacle that was restraining her.

The tentacles suddenly felt pain and trembled violently in the air like living creatures, and the ax swung by the boy suddenly fell to the ground at the same time.

He covered one arm, blood oozing out from between his fingers, and looked at Si Long in disbelief.

She did not expect that these generated tentacles would be injured simultaneously with his body.

And the moment the tentacles were released, Si Long seized the opportunity and immediately broke away from the control. He quickly returned to the window with a single step and jumped down without any hesitation.

That was her first step, to leave the building.

She wanted to verify whether her conjecture about the boundaries of dreams was correct.

And the next second, the boy flashed behind her.

"Where are you going? Aren't you taking me with you?"

"Sister."

A demonic whisper appeared in her ears.

You are really haunted. I have endured you for a damn long time.

"Get out!" Si Long was furious!

Her eyes widened with anger, veins popped out on her forehead, and she turned around with all her strength and launched a solid flying kick. Only boys knew how powerful this kick was.

The boy seemed to have been on guard for a long time, with his hands defensive and ready to receive this kick.

But he underestimated the sharply increasing damage value of a furious person, not to mention that their physical fitness itself was not at the same level.

All I heard was, click!!!

A dull cracking sound was particularly clear in the air.

Si Long's kick directly broke his defensive arm.

The boy's face wrinkled up, and he flew straight out like a cannonball. Within a few seconds, he heard a "bang!"

It has been embedded on the outer wall of Yongye Bureau.

Si Long figured everything out just by the sound of his voice, not even bothering to look back with contempt.

After a roll to relieve her stress, she landed lightly, and continued running along the street into the distance without looking back. She had to seize the time.

If it goes as expected, she won't be able to kill him in this dream. He is like a dungeon boss with constant rebirth of energy, and he will be able to catch up to him very quickly.

The most important thing for her now is to take the next step immediately.

The first step is to leave the building, and the second step is to find the boundary of the dream.

In the dream, she always reached the moment when she was exhausted, and that was when she was truly at her wits' end and at the mercy of others.

Si Long ran as hard as he could on the street, but there was no trace of human activity wherever he passed.
